description: Generative AI for Synthetic Medical Image Augmentation - Generate synthetic X-ray/MRI images to augment imbalanced medical datasets

userStories.title: Setup data loading pipeline
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to load and preprocess medical images (X-rays) so that the GAN can train on them

userStories.title: Implement DCGAN generator and discriminator
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to implement the GAN architecture so that synthetic medical images can be generated

userStories.title: Implement GAN training loop with error handling
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to train the GAN with proper error handling so that model converges successfully

userStories.title: Generate synthetic medical images
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to generate synthetic X-ray images so that dataset augmentation can be performed

userStories.title: Implement classifier for evaluation
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to implement a classifier so that synthetic image quality can be evaluated

userStories.title: Compute FID score for quality evaluation
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to compute FID scores so that synthetic image quality can be quantified
acceptanceCriteria: FID computation between real and synthetic images

userStories.title: Create Streamlit demo application
userStories.description: As a user, I want to generate synthetic images through a UI so that I can interact with the system
acceptanceCriteria: Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Run augmentation experiments
userStories.description: As a developer, I need to run classifier experiments so that augmentation effectiveness can be measured
